name: Grand Hotel du Palais Royal
positioning: Intimate, apartment-like hotel in Paris's 1st arrondissement, beside the Palais Royal gardens and next door to the Louvre, with rooms designed by Pierre-Yves Rochon
best_for: Travelers who want to stay beside the Palais Royal gardens and the Louvre

facts.text: The hotel is at 4 Rue de Valois in Paris's 1st arrondissement.
Rooms and suites are particularly bright, with soft colours and well thought-out comfort.
Room materials mix velvet, leather and silk.
Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel feels like a series of apartments, managed more like a family-owned boutique property.
Common areas have reading material, from newspapers to art books.
The Holidermie Spa offers expert facial and body treatments.
Cafe 52 serves organic, balanced and seasonal dishes throughout the day.
The hotel offers a healthy, gourmet champagne brunch every Sunday.
Cafe 52 and the Signature Suites can host custom events.
The hotel won Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2017 through 2024 and in 2026.

highlights.text: The hotel is a stone's throw from the Palais Royal and its romantic formal gardens, next door to the Louvre and the Tuileries Gardens.
The rooms were designed by Pierre-Yves Rochon in warm tones ranging from light wood to chocolate, light greens and powdery pinks.
Cafe 52 has a vast terrace on the quiet Place de Valois.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the on-site spa as modest.
Cafe 52's outdoor seating is available during the warmer months.
Conde Nast Traveler calls it entry-level luxury, without a marquee chef or spa products.
